visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a white RVCA brand hoodie, looks intently at a white and grey pet water fountain on a kitchen counter. A steady stream of clear water flows from a spout into a white, tilted bowl. The man's hand is near his chin in a thoughtful pose. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene shifts to a tiled floor where a round, white cat water fountain sits near a metal cat cage. The man's hand points to the device and the wet floor around it, highlighting a leak. The background shows a white Mitsubishi appliance and grey walls. The camera is handheld and moves slightly. (3) The man holds a large brown cardboard box for a 'Petgravity' water dispenser. He points to diagrams on the box illustrating the tilted bowl and water recycling system. His facial expressions are animated as he explains the product's benefits. The box text is in Simplified Chinese. (4) A series of close-up shots show the unboxing process. The man pulls out a grey recycling tray, a white drinking bowl, and a clear 3L water tank. He holds an Apple Pencil next to the components to show their size. The parts are laid out on a white countertop. (5) The man interacts with the touch control panel on top of the assembled unit, which has a black circular display. He connects a white power bank to show the device's portability. A tabby cat enters the frame and starts drinking from the bowl. The man smiles at the camera.
